why: Every model id a target runtime documents as its default, or as the target of a default alias, must price at an exact DEFAULT_RATES row. The calendar staleness check cannot see a default change; tests/documented-default-models.test.cjs turns one into a failing test once the id is recorded here. Update this file whenever a runtime's model documentation changes, citing the page and the date it was read.

defaults.role: the default model on every Claude plan and the Anthropic API, and on Bedrock, Google Cloud and Claude Platform on AWS (Claude Code 2.1.280 and later); also where the opus alias resolves on those providers
the target of the fable and best aliases where Fable is available
the target of the sonnet alias on the Anthropic API
the default model on Microsoft Foundry, and the sonnet alias on Bedrock and Google Cloud
the target of the sonnet alias on Claude Platform on AWS
the target of the opus alias on Microsoft Foundry
the current Haiku in the models overview lineup, which the haiku alias uses (model-config names no Haiku version)
the model Codex's configuration docs set as the default (model = "gpt-6-sol" in config-basic and the sample config)
the faster, lower-cost model Codex's subagent docs recommend beside gpt-6-sol

no_documented_default.why: The settings reference documents model.name with no default value, and Antigravity's models page lists its models without naming one as the default.
The config reference documents the model key without a default; the model comes from the provider the user configures.
Copilot CLI routes requests through its Auto model selection (release 1.0.87 adds organisation defaults for the Auto tier) and documents no fixed default model id.
